en.html:
I went speechless, ground my teeth, and groaned. All three together.
No, I was not practicing an act. This talent came out naturally.

With the besieging army beginning to withdraw, I should finally have had my chance to get inside the castle.
No—once, I actually did get inside.

Straightaway, pushed back out.

The place had become a madhouse, a forest of swords and a rain of bullets flying every which way. Staying there was simply not possible.

機会を得られたはずだった。
　いや、一度は実際に踏み入った。

　けれど、すぐに押し出された。

　狂躁の巷と化し剣林弾雨が縦横無尽に飛び交う城内
で踏み止まるのは不可能だったから。

en.html:
What was happening in front of me, that I understood. Better than the people who had themselves turned into a mob.
The Silver Star had appeared and begun its mental contamination. What other explanation was there?

But Hikaru Minato—the Silver Star—was supposed to be in Izu Horigoe. Why was she here in Fudaraku Castle?
Had Chachamaru Ashikaga brought her?

Then what was Chachamaru trying to do?
Let destruction and slaughter loose inside this castle—what purpose did that serve?

いる。当の暴徒と化した彼らより理解している。
　銀星号が現れ、精神汚染を開始したのだ。それ以外
に考えられない。

　しかし、どうして伊豆堀越にいたはずの湊斗光――
銀星号が普陀楽城に現れるのか。
　足利茶々丸が連れてきたのか。

　だとすると、茶々丸の目的は何なのか。
　この城に破壊と殺戮の化身を解き放って、何の意味
があるのか――

Things would pass beyond repair.

en.html:
Impatience surged up inside me.
Still, turn my head as much as I liked, work my sensors as much as I liked—not one opening.

Confusion, disorder, chaos. Too much of all three.
Forget going forward. If I didn't keep retreating, I would be swallowed up and crushed in it myself.

What was I supposed to do...?

No voice came out.

Countless stars were shining.
Silver stars—with limbs, wings, and blades.

They danced in the sky, singing their song of madness at full voice.
Warriors who challenged them... warriors who tried to escape... the same result. Shot down by a brutal difference in performance.

These were not the Silver Star itself.
Something else.

But in every way, terribly alike.

en.html:
Kanae"You want to see Kageaki?"
Muramasa"...Yes."
Kanae"Then please take him a message. —The occupation army will use its decisive weapon, the Forged Bomb."
Kanae"When it falls on Fudaraku, everyone in the castle will probably die. No, the damage may even reach the streets of Kamakura."
Muramasa"...WHAT?!"
Kanae"Please. For now, believe me without questioning it and tell Kageaki exactly this. —The only way to prevent that operation is to make the Rokuhara shogunate cease to exist."
Kanae"Without an enemy, they cannot drop the bomb. The key is Shirou Kuniuji Ashikaga."
Kanae"That is the message. Understood?"
Muramasa"Y-yes."
Kanae"I intended to do it myself... but that doesn't seem likely to work. So I'm leaving it to you and Kageaki."
Kanae"I'll evacuate the people of Kamakura in case the worst happens. Together with His Highness Prince Maidono and the chief, we'll reduce the harm as much as we can."
Muramasa"All right. But how are you going to get me into the castle?"
Kanae"Put out those threads again, please."
Muramasa"?"
Kanae"Onto this arrow."

ja.html:
香奈枝「あなたの目的は、景明さまに会うこと？」
村正「……そうよ」
香奈枝「でしたら、あのかたに伝言をお願いします。 　――進駐軍は決戦兵器鍛造雷弾を使用する」
香奈枝「これが普陀楽に投下された時、城の人間は 全滅するでしょう。 　いえ、もしかしたら鎌倉市街にまで被害が 及ぶかもしれない」
村正「……はぁ!?」
香奈枝「いいから。今は疑わず信じて、景明さまに そのまま伝えてください。 　――この作戦を未然に防ぐ方法は、六波羅・・・ 幕府を消滅させる・・・・・・・・ことだけ」
香奈枝「敵がいなければ爆弾投下はできませんから。 　鍵は足利四郎邦氏」
香奈枝「伝言は以上です。 　よろしくて？」
村正「え、ええ」
香奈枝「本当はわたくしがやるつもりだったのです けど……どうも見込みが無さそうなので。 　あなたと景明さまにお願いします」
香奈枝「わたくしは万一に備えて鎌倉の人々を避難 させましょう。 　舞殿宮殿下や署長さんとも協力して、少し でも被害を減らします」
村正「わかった。 　けど、どうやって私を城内に送るの？」
香奈枝「さっきの糸を出してくださいまし」
村正「？」
香奈枝「それを、この矢に」

Her tsurugi took a firing stance.
I let the tension out of my body and prepared for the coming instant.

...A tsurugi by itself does not get to fly. Bird, butterfly—if that is your independent form, fine, go ahead. The rest of us have to join with a pilot and become an armored warrior. Then only does the power to rise into the sky arrive.

And here I was, by myself. Flying not included.

Unless we used a little jugaad!

Couldn't dodge.
